rv.q: It’s tosh, but somehow it works.
This aggressively stupid musical version of the Julia Roberts smash justifies the terrible Broadway reviews
Now, nearly one and a half years later, the entire cast and production return with more confidence and panache.

cn.t: Critics are divided: audiences cheer while reviewers wince. Some find it a fun, crowd-pleasing escape; others call it witless and dated. A guilty pleasure at best.
